key_idea: Count the cubes in each solid and find the one with exactly 8.
steps: A is flat: 2 rows of 5 cubes, so 10 cubes.
B is flat: 3 rows of 3 cubes, so 9 cubes.
D is a wall 2 cubes tall and 4 cubes long: 4 + 4 = 8 cubes.
D uses every one of the 8 cubes.

choice_feedback.A: A has 2 rows of 5 cubes. That is 10 cubes, 2 too many.
choice_feedback.B: B has 3 rows of 3 cubes. That is 9 cubes, 1 too many.
choice_feedback.C: C has 6 cubes you can see. Even with a hidden cube under the top, that is only 7.
choice_feedback.E: E has 3 cubes on top, 3 under them and 1 more on the right: 7 cubes.
